title: Count the Number of Special Characters I
statement: The string `word` is made of English letters in either case. Call a letter special when `word` contains it at least once as a lowercase character and at least once as an uppercase character (in any positions and any order). Return how many of the 26 letters are special.
constraints: word contains only lowercase and uppercase English letters
notes:
## Intuition

A letter's position in `word` does not matter, only whether each of its two forms shows up somewhere. Scanning `word` again for every letter would work, but putting all characters into a set once makes each "is it there?" question O(1). Then we just ask that question for both cases of each of the 26 letters.

## Approach

1. Build `seen`, the set of characters in `word`.
2. Walk `code` over the character codes of `'a'` to `'z'` (97 to 122).
3. Form `lower` and its uppercase partner `upper`.
4. If `seen` holds both, the letter is special, so increase `count`.
5. Return `count`.

## Example 1, step by step

`word = "aaAbcBC"` gives `seen = {a, A, b, c, B, C}`.
- `a`: both `a` and `A` are present, `count = 1`.
- `b`: both `b` and `B`, `count = 2`.
- `c`: both `c` and `C`, `count = 3`.
- `d` to `z`: neither form appears. The answer is `3`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n + 26): one pass to fill the set, then a fixed 26 checks.
- Space: O(1): the set holds at most 52 distinct characters.

## Pitfalls

- Count letters, not occurrences: `"AAaa"` has one special letter, not two or four.
- Both forms are required; a letter seen only in uppercase is not special.
- The order of the two forms does not matter here (unlike the follow-up problem, part II).

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `seen` | set of the characters that occur in `word` |
| `count` | number of special letters found so far |
| `code` | character code of the current lowercase letter |
| `lower`, `upper` | the current letter in lowercase and uppercase |

narration.2: Put every character of word into a set so each presence check is O(1).
narration.3: count tracks how many special letters we have found.
narration.4: Try each lowercase letter from 'a' (97) to 'z' (122).
narration.5: Turn the code into the lowercase letter...
narration.7: The letter is special only if both forms appear somewhere in word.
narration.8: It is, so count it once.
narration.11: All 26 letters were checked; return the total.
